#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string str;
    while (std::cin >> n >> str) {
        std::string outside, inside;
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            if (str[i] == '(') {
                inside.push_back('_');
                i++;
                while (i < n && str[i] != ')') {
                    inside.push_back(str[i]);
                    i++;
                }
            } else if (str[i] == ')') {
                outside.push_back('_');
            } else {
                outside.push_back(str[i]);
            }
            i++;
        }
        long res2 = std::count(inside.begin(), inside.end(), '_');
        long underscore_out = std::count(outside.begin(), outside.end(), '_');
        long non_underscore_out = outside.size() - underscore_out;
        long res1 = std::max(underscore_out, non_underscore_out);
        std::cout << res1 << " " << res2 << std::endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
